hints.title: Monotonic Feasibility
hints.text: If a target water level V is achievable, any lower level is also achievable.

hints.title: Binary Search on Float Range
hints.text: Binary search the target level in the continuous range from 0 to the maximum bucket volume.

hints.title: Compare Excess to Deficit
hints.text: For a candidate level V, compute the total excess water discounted by the loss percentage, and verify if it covers the total deficit.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Continuous fluid simulation cannot be solved with discrete greedy steps.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 80 iterations of binary search over N buckets achieves 10^-5 precision in O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate binary search on answer with floating point threshold condition.
